1.
Heard Mr. Rakesh Dubey, learned counsel for the applicants and learned Additional Government Advocate for the State.

2. This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.666 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station Kotwali, District Gorakhpur..
3. During arguments, learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that since the charge sheet has been submitted against the applicants, he does not want to press the prayer for release the Satyendra Kumar Srivastava And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with the direction that in case the applicants appear before the court below and file regular bail application, the same shall be heard and disposed of expeditiously by the court below in view of the settled law laid by this Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (Supra).
5. The present anticipatory bail application stands disposed of.
